p: A lion has sharp teeth as well.
A shark has very sharp teeth! Why do some animals have sharp teeth?
A cow has strong teeth for grinding.
A bird does not have teeth. How does a bird eat?
I used to have front teeth.
My front teeth fell out! How many teeth do you have?
